project_type: PahadPulse — a closed-loop hospitality guest-intelligence platform. Python FastAPI backend + Next.js (App Router, TypeScript) staff dashboard. Multi-subsystem: Market Radar, Destination Lens, In-Stay Sentinel, Guest Compass, Bhasha Concierge, plus platform/security/privacy and a reproducible demo.
build_system: Backend: uv-managed virtualenv with pyproject.toml (pin Python 3.11 via `.python-version` / pyenv local 3.11.15; system `python3` is 3.9 so DO NOT rely on it — use `uv run` or an explicit 3.11 interpreter). Frontend: npm with Next.js. Root: a Makefile and a single `scripts/demo.sh` (or `make demo`) orchestrating both.
test_framework: Backend: pytest (unit + property-based tests via hypothesis for round-trip/invariant/metamorphic properties called out in the spec). Frontend: Vitest + React Testing Library for component logic; Playwright optional/skippable.
build_command: Backend: `cd backend && uv sync` then `uv run python -c 'import app'`. Frontend: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`.
test_command: Backend: `cd backend && uv run pytest`. Frontend: `cd frontend && npm test` (vitest run) and `npm run lint`.
verification_instructions: 1) Backend: `cd backend && uv sync && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest`. 2) Frontend: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test`. 3) End-to-end demo: run the single documented command (Req 34.1) e.g. `make demo` / `scripts/demo.sh` which seeds the sample dataset, a Cluster of >=5 Properties, synthetic Stays and Property_Facts, starts the API and dashboard. The scripted demo scenario (Req 34.2) must cover What-If Simulator, Time Machine, Checkout Shield + live WhatsApp complaint (mock gateway in sandbox), Playbook, Gap Finder, Destination heatmap + Evidence Packet, and the benchmark table.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Dataset artifacts live under `data/` and are checked in: the sample Mussoorie review dataset (JSON), the dataset datasheet (Req 2.8, markdown), the Hinglish_Test_Set of 300-500 labelled reviews with labelling-guideline docs + Cohen's kappa (Req 16.1-16.2). The published Review_Record JSON schema is checked in under `backend/app/schemas/review_record.schema.json`. Benchmark result tables (Req 16) are produced by the Benchmark_Harness and may be committed as JSON/markdown under `data/benchmark/`. Regenerate dataset/seed with the seed script; regenerate benchmark with `uv run python -m app.benchmark.run`.
setup_instructions: Backend: `cd backend && uv python pin 3.11.15 && uv sync`. Frontend: `cd frontend && npm install`. A root `.env.example` documents all external-service config (LLM API, Twilio/Meta WhatsApp, geocoder, encryption keys, pseudonymisation salt) per Req 32.2; copy to `.env`. All externals MUST default to local/mock/fallback implementations so the system runs end-to-end with NO live third-party credentials.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET: pip/uv and npm installs are available. HOWEVER heavy ML models (MuRIL/IndicBERT), live Twilio/Meta WhatsApp, external LLM APIs, external geocoders may NOT be reachable or practical to provision here. REQUIRED ARCHITECTURE: abstract every external behind an interface with a working local/mock/fallback implementation selected via env var. (a) Sentiment_Engine: define a model interface; provide a deterministic lexicon/heuristic fallback classifier that satisfies the spec's behavioural contracts (idempotence, evidence spans as substrings of ORIGINAL text, model-version tagging, unsupported-language handling) so tests pass offline; wire a real MuRIL/IndicBERT adapter behind the same interface, loaded only if the model is available. (b) LLM API: interface + deterministic template fallback (Req 12.9, 34.3) labelled template-generated. (c) WhatsApp_Gateway: interface + in-process mock that simulates inbound webhooks and records outbound messages, with HMAC signature verification implemented and testable (Req 20.4). (d) Voice_Pipeline (Whisper): interface + stub. (e) Geocoder: curated local gazetteer first (Req 14.2) + optional external adapter. Default Python 3.9 on PATH is too old — pin 3.11. System default DB: SQLite for the demo (no external DB daemon required).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists yet (greenfield). Create one plus a top-level README with the single demo command. Keep secrets out of source control (Req 32.2): salt and keys only in env/secrets store, never in dataset files or repo. Dataset datasheet record counts MUST match the actual sample dataset counts (Req 2.8). Hinglish_Test_Set must contain NO reviews used to tune the Sentiment_Engine (Req 16.6). Conventional-commit style types used in features: feat/chore/docs/fix/refactor.
key_patterns: Clean layering in the backend: `app/models` (pydantic + ORM), `app/schemas` (JSON schema + pydantic I/O), `app/services/<subsystem>` (market_radar, destination_lens, sentinel, guest_compass, concierge), `app/adapters` (sentiment, llm, whatsapp, voice, geocoder — interface + fallback impls), `app/api/routers` (FastAPI routers per subsystem), `app/core` (config/settings via pydantic-settings reading env, security/auth, audit log, db session). Everything that produces a displayed number must be traceable to source records to support the Drilldown (Req 27). Frontend: Next.js App Router with a cohesive themed design system — green/white palette with a forest accent and a Mussoorie / Uttarakhand hill-town visual identity (treat visual polish as a first-class requirement, per user emphasis). Centralize theme tokens (Tailwind config + CSS variables), reusable component library, consistent layout shell, and make this theme visible across ALL dashboard views.
relevant_files: README.md (demo command, architecture, Deep vs Minimal map)
Makefile and scripts/demo.sh (single demo command, Req 34.1-34.2)
backend/app/core/config.py (pydantic-settings; feature flags select real-vs-fallback adapters)
directory_structure: Repo root: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, Makefile, scripts/, .env.example, data/ (checked-in dataset + datasheet + hinglish test set + benchmark outputs), backend/ (FastAPI service), frontend/ (Next.js dashboard), .agents/tasks/ (this plan). backend/app subpackages: core, models, schemas, adapters, services (per subsystem), api/routers, seed. frontend: app/ (routes per subsystem view), components/ (themed design-system + feature cards + Drilldown), lib/ (api client, theme tokens).
